nom: No7 Radiance+ 15% Vitamin C Face Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with acne-prone, oily skin reported the serum caused tiny pimple-like bumps and made her skin worse.
segments.dry: One reviewer with very dry skin said the serum sat on the skin like a barrier and left it soft with no breakouts, using it both morning and night.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin described it as a good fit for their skin type and reported reduced redness and smoother skin with consistent use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or semi-sensitive skin mostly reported no irritation and gentle tolerance, though one non-sensitive reviewer developed perioral dermatitis and another reported a chemical burn and severe allergic reaction, and one sensitive-skin user felt tingling near the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mentioned aging or mature skin reported a glow, firmer feel, and smoothing of fine lines with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging reported a fuller, firmer, more radiant look and smoother fine lines over weeks of use; results were described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers said the serum left skin feeling hydrated, supple, or soft, and one with dry skin praised its moisture-barrier effect; a few others found it non-drying compared to prior vitamin C products.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, including those with rosacea, reported calmer, less red skin after consistent use; against this, three reviewers had acute reactions with red, itchy, burning skin, and one developed a persistent rash.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with perioral dermatitis described flaking and bumps after two weeks of use, and another reported ongoing stinging described as a chemical burn, while most other reviewers reported no irritation or barrier issues.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers targeting dark spots or hyperpigmentation reported fading and more even tone within weeks; several others saw no change in their dark spots even after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers reported fewer breakouts or faster resolution of hormonal acne and old acne scars, but one reviewer with acne-prone skin said new pimple-like bumps appeared and her acne worsened.
concerns.oiliness: A single reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reported the product made her skin worse rather than helping oil control; no other reviewer specifically addressed oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Dropper mechanism disliked, air exposure worry
Good value for price versus premium serums

extraits.texte: I tried this as a more affordable vitamin C serum since I wasn't seeing results with my expensive one. Majorly regret it. After 2 weeks I developed a red rash around my mouth and nose (perioral dermatitis), flakes, and bumps. I did a patch test and didn't have a result, this was a buildup over 2 weeks of using the product in the morning. I don't have sensitive skin at all so I really wasn't expecting this, even at 15%. Still trying to get it to go away weeks later. Also, it pilled underneath my Your Skin But Better CC cream no matter how long I let it dry. I'm going back to the pricey stuff I guess.

extraits.titre: Did not see a positive result.
extraits.texte: I tried this as directed and have not notices any changes for the better on my dark spots or complexion on my skin. It separates my makeup and instead of making it smoother tiny pimple like bumps appeared all over my face. I do have acne prone and oily skin and did not help it but made it worse.

extraits.titre: Used whole bottle prior to review
extraits.texte: I always check reviews before buying but my phone had no service while in Ulta. So I bought this as I've had good results with vitamin C products. Then I got home and looked at some poor reviews! Oh well, I'm stuck using it now, I thought. Yes, it's sticky, but only while applying. It seems to sit on face rather than get absorbed, but guess what? I absolutely love it! I think it forms a magnificent barrier that keeps moisture in. Baby soft skin in the mornings! No breakouts. My skin is very dry. I used both am and pm.

To start, I am mid 30s with combo skin and live in a hot, humid state. I have very mild rosacea so I love a good Vit C serum to combat the redness I have on my checks. I have used a TON of high priced and drug store versions and this is my fav so far. I saw a difference after only a couple days of use - less redness and more smoothness to my face. With higher concentrated versions, my skin has burned before - but not with this product! It also dried very quickly and not sticky at all which was super helpful in completing my daily routine. Bonus - no smell which was nice. I would def purchase this again.

I generally avoid daily vitamin c application due to the skin drying effects of a previous brand used. My experience using No7's serum is much better! The daily glow they advertise is very subtle, but I do see a definite change in skin texture and color after using consistently for 28 days. I no longer have a red patch of skin on my cheeks! It's non-drying or irritated. It also absorbs quickly, not leaving a tacky feeling behind. Highly recommend!

I usually used vitamin C on morning, but si have rosacea so not every Vitamin C is good for my skin, mostly vitamin c are strong for my skin. But when I used this my skin tolerates it very well. Have a good vitamin c concentration. It's an excellent option for rosacea skin.

I am 43 and I have always been pretty proactive about wearing sunscreen, especially on my face. I do have some sunspots around my eye area, on my temples and on my hands. I have a rather large one on my right temple that I really have been focusing on. I have been applying No7 the Radiance+ once daily before my moisturizer in the morning. First thing I noticed right out of the bottle is the amazing scent. I don't care for heavily scented products, but this is very light and pleasant. It's a great price for the size and a little goes a long way. It has a nice texture when smoothing it on the skin and the slight stickiness goes away if you let it set for a minute or two before applying moisturizer. I can already see a difference in the spots on my face, especially the larger one on my temple, and my skin feels very soft. I am going to start working on some of the spots of my hands and expect to see similar results.
